title: Sabbath Controversies, the Twelve, and Blessings

questions.question: What were the disciples doing on a Sabbath while going through the grainfields that the Pharisees said was not lawful?
options: They plucked and ate some heads of grain, rubbing them in their hands
They were using sickles to harvest the fields for profit
They set up camp and built a fire on the Sabbath
They stole grain from the temple treasury
questions.correctAnswer: They plucked and ate some heads of grain, rubbing them in their hands
questions.explanation: Luke 6:1 (ESV): "On a Sabbath, while he was going through the grainfields, his disciples plucked and ate some heads of grain, rubbing them in their hands."

questions.question: Who did Jesus give as an example of someone who did what was not lawful, eating the bread of the Presence when he was hungry?
options: David
Solomon
Elijah
Moses
questions.explanation: Luke 6:3-4 (ESV): "And Jesus answered them, 'Have you not read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him: how he entered the house of God and took and ate the bread of the Presence...'"

questions.question: In the synagogue on another Sabbath, there was a man with a withered right hand. Why were the scribes and Pharisees watching Jesus closely?
options: To see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, so that they might find a reason to accuse him
Because they wanted to believe in his miracles
Because they were amazed at his teaching
To see if he would ask for money to heal
questions.correctAnswer: To see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, so that they might find a reason to accuse him
questions.explanation: Luke 6:7 (ESV): "And the scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, so that they might find a reason to accuse him."

questions.question: What question did Jesus ask the scribes and Pharisees before healing the man with the withered hand?
options: "I ask you, is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do harm, to save life or to destroy it?"
"Does not the law say to heal the sick on every day?"
"Should this man suffer another day because of your rules?"
"Why are you so hard of heart?"
questions.correctAnswer: "I ask you, is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do harm, to save life or to destroy it?"
questions.explanation: Luke 6:9 (ESV): "And Jesus said to them, 'I ask you, is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do harm, to save life or to destroy it?'"

questions.question: Before choosing His twelve apostles, where did Jesus go and what did He do all night?
options: He went out to the mountain to pray, and all night he continued in prayer to God
He stayed in the synagogue debating the scribes
He sailed across the sea of Galilee teaching the crowds
He fasted in the wilderness without sleep
questions.correctAnswer: He went out to the mountain to pray, and all night he continued in prayer to God
questions.explanation: Luke 6:12 (ESV): "In these days he went out to the mountain to pray, and all night he continued in prayer to God."

questions.question: Which of the following disciples was NOT listed among the twelve apostles in Luke 6?
options: Barnabas
Simon, whom he named Peter
Matthew
Judas Iscariot
questions.explanation: Luke 6:14-16 lists the twelve apostles; Barnabas is a later companion of Paul, not an original apostle.

questions.question: In the great crowd on the level place, Jesus gave His Sermon on the Plain. He began: "Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is..." what?
options: "...the kingdom of God."
"...the wealth of heaven."
"...peace that passes understanding."
"...the inheritance of the earth."
questions.explanation: Luke 6:20 (ESV): "And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said: 'Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.'"

questions.question: What "woe" does Jesus pronounce upon the rich in Luke 6?
options: "But woe to you who are rich, for you have received your consolation."
"Woe to you who are rich, for your gold will rust entirely."
"Woe to you who are rich, for the poor will judge you."
"Woe to you who are rich, because you lack nothing further."
questions.correctAnswer: "But woe to you who are rich, for you have received your consolation."
questions.explanation: Luke 6:24 (ESV): "But woe to you who are rich, for you have received your consolation."

questions.question: According to Jesus, how should you treat those who curse you and abuse you?
options: Bless those who curse you, pray for those who abuse you
Strike them back with a staff of righteousness
Avoid them entirely and shake the dust from your feet
Curse them back in the name of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Bless those who curse you, pray for those who abuse you
questions.explanation: Luke 6:28 (ESV): "bless those who curse you, pray for those who abuse you."

questions.question: What is the Golden Rule as stated by Jesus in Luke 6:31?
options: "And as you wish that others would do to you, do so to them."
"Do unto others before they do unto you."
"Love your neighbor and despise your enemy."
"A life for a life, an eye for an eye."
questions.correctAnswer: "And as you wish that others would do to you, do so to them."
questions.explanation: Luke 6:31 (ESV): "And as you wish that others would do to you, do so to them."

questions.question: Jesus teaches not to judge so that you will not be judged. He says, "Forgive, and you will be forgiven; give, and..." what?
options: "...it will be given to you. Good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, will be put into your lap."
"...you shall never lack anything."
"...the angels will carry you to heaven."
"...the world will praise your name."
questions.correctAnswer: "...it will be given to you. Good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, will be put into your lap."
questions.explanation: Luke 6:38 (ESV): "give, and it will be given to you. Good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over, will be put into your lap. For with the measure you use it will be measured back to you."

questions.question: Why does Jesus question a hypocrite for seeing the speck in his brother's eye?
options: "When you yourself do not see the log that is in your own eye?"
"When you cannot see at all?"
"When the speck is so small?"
"When your brother is holier than you?"
questions.correctAnswer: "When you yourself do not see the log that is in your own eye?"
questions.explanation: Luke 6:41 (ESV): "Why do you see the speck that is in your brother's eye, but do not notice the log that is in your own eye?"

questions.question: What determines the kind of fruit a tree produces?
options: The nature of the tree (for no good tree bears bad fruit, nor a bad tree bears good fruit)
The rain and soil only
The size of its branches
The care given by the gardener
questions.correctAnswer: The nature of the tree (for no good tree bears bad fruit, nor a bad tree bears good fruit)
questions.explanation: Luke 6:43-44 (ESV): "For no good tree bears bad fruit, nor again does a bad tree bear good fruit, for each tree is known by its own fruit..."

questions.question: Where does the good person produce good out of?
options: The good treasure of his heart
His righteous mind
The law written on scrolls
His strict adherence to traditions
questions.correctAnswer: The good treasure of his heart
questions.explanation: Luke 6:45 (ESV): "The good person out of the good treasure of his heart produces good... for out of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks."

questions.question: Everyone who comes to Jesus, hears His words, and does them is compared to what kind of builder?
options: A man building a house, who dug deep and laid the foundation on the rock
A man building a house quickly on the sand
A man building a high tower of wood
A man painting his house brilliantly
questions.correctAnswer: A man building a house, who dug deep and laid the foundation on the rock
questions.explanation: Luke 6:48 (ESV): "he is like a man building a house, who dug deep and laid the foundation on the rock. And when a flood arose, the stream broke against that house and could not shake it, because it had been well built."

key_verse_text: "And as you wish that others would do to you, do so to them."
